title: Carmen B NDE 2574
content: Commonalities with all three events: Looking down on body in hospital bed (1 event). Serenity, soft music, sense of great peace, soft colors not of the physical world (indescribable). White/pale yellow soft light, sense of floating. Trees but not like normal trees, no other entities present. Desire not to return. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 29 August 2006 / July 1970/ July 1969 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal All was more vivid, and a greater sense of reality, desire not to return, intense sense of peace. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Last experience: rolling dunes reddish and pale yellow into the distance. Some dunes displayed peaks. Eye perspective panning over the scene. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither No time perception at all. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Greater clarity, greater degree of peripheral vision, colors more vivid, greater degree of brightness, some degree of transparency (like a vision but untouchable, yet very real). Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Heard absolutely nothing other than music and was very soft. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Also saw through the light: empty countryside included trees with light shade no green at all. Also water, intense blue. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm as described above What emotions did you feel during the experience? At first fear with the out of body experience, then emotions changed 180 degrees. Extreme peacefulness and joy. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Past flashed before me, out of my control Being able to let go of all things of this world. Will never repeat mistakes from the past if given a new lease on life. Will live a good life. Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A conscious decision to 'return' to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Lack of acceptance of the tenets of organized religion. What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Lack of acceptance of the tenets of organized religion. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes A sense of evil in the universe that was a tangible thing. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Hold others to a higher standard and tend to not tolerate a sense of lack of goodwill towards me. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Not able to describe colors, music. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes About a week for one experience only - kept silent about the other two. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No A strong sense of direction in life that awaited me. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real One hundred percent reality. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real When I go back and think of my experience I long for the feelings I experienced and want them in my life here. Also I was free from pain. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? A sense of a lack of understanding why I was constantly sent back.

environment.environment_other_detail: Rolling dunes (reddish and pale yellow) into the distance; empty countryside with trees (no green); intense blue water; soft colors not of the physical world.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Soft music; soft colors; floating; trees unlike normal trees; rolling dunes; intense blue water; no entities present; desire not to return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Three separate events were reported; common elements included OBE, tunnel, light, and unearthly landscapes; highest consciousness described during the last experience while viewing dunes.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Three NDE events with shared elements (OBE, serenity/peace, soft light/colors, floating, no entities).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Soft music as the only sound; trees with no green at all; rolling reddish/pale yellow dunes; experiencer reports a tangible 'sense of evil in the universe'; "a lack of understanding why I was constantly sent back."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Past flashed before me, out of my control.” “A conscious decision to 'return' to life.” “One hundred percent reality.” “When I go back and think of my experience I long for the feelings I experienced and want them in my life here.”
